name: Back from the brink
blurb: East Neuk Links in Fife went bust and you picked it up for a song. The greens are tired, the clubhouse leaks, and the bank wants results.
goalText: Get East Neuk Links to 8 out of 10 reputation with £300,000 in the bank

name: The waiting list
blurb: The owners of Tatton Edge in Cheshire want a proper members' club. The kind with a waiting list, a dress code and a portrait of a former captain in the bar.
goalText: Fill every membership at Tatton Edge, with a waiting list

name: Stockbroker belt
blurb: Three little southern nine holers, and Meridian Capital owns the two best clubs in the region. They would quite like yours as well.
goalText: Own the highest rated course in the south for ten days running

name: Rising tide
blurb: Pegwell Bay Links in Kent has hosted the big amateur events and dreams of The Championship. The trouble is the sea, which would like it back.
goalText: Host The Championship at Pegwell Bay Links

name: Shoestring
blurb: Fifty grand and a dream. Go from an empty field to hosting The Championship before the money men beat you to it.
